description: Complete replacement of Muslim Pedia with CatatinAja - Core app structure, routing, storage layer, and transaction management (add/edit/delete income & expenses with categories)
steps: Replace index.html entirely with CatatinAja structure. Create pages: Dashboard (home), Tambah Transaksi (add transaction), Riwayat (history/transactions list), Laporan (reports), and Pengaturan (settings). Use bottom navigation with 4 tabs: Home, Transaksi, Laporan, Pengaturan. Keep same architectural pattern: single HTML file with section.page elements, hash-based routing.

Rewrite js/storage.js as a localStorage abstraction for financial data. Keys: catatinaja_transactions (array of transaction objects), catatinaja_budgets (budget per category per month), catatinaja_settings (theme, currency format, etc). Transaction object: {id, type:'income'|'expense', amount, category, description, date, createdAt}. Include CRUD operations: getTransactions(), addTransaction(), updateTransaction(), deleteTransaction(), getBudgets(), setBudget(), getSettings(), saveSettings().

Rewrite js/data.js to contain category definitions. Expense categories (with icons): Makanan & Minuman (fa-utensils), Transportasi (fa-car), Belanja (fa-shopping-bag), Tagihan & Utilitas (fa-file-invoice), Hiburan (fa-film), Kesehatan (fa-heart-pulse), Pendidikan (fa-graduation-cap), Investasi (fa-chart-line), Lainnya (fa-ellipsis). Income categories: Gaji (fa-briefcase), Freelance (fa-laptop), Bisnis (fa-store), Investasi (fa-chart-line), Hadiah (fa-gift), Lainnya (fa-ellipsis).

Rewrite js/app.js as the main controller. Implement: hash-based router (handleRoute for #home, #add, #transactions, #reports, #settings, #edit/:id), Dashboard page showing total saldo/pemasukan/pengeluaran for current month plus recent transactions list, Add Transaction page with form (type toggle income/expense, amount input with Rp prefix, category selector grid, description input, date picker defaulting to today), Transaction history page with month filter and list of all transactions grouped by date, Edit/delete transaction functionality.
Remove js/api.js file (no external API needed for this app - all data is local).

Rewrite css/style.css completely for CatatinAja. Use a modern financial app color scheme: primary blue (#4F46E5 indigo), success green (#10B981), danger red (#EF4444). Keep same patterns: CSS variables, dark mode support via [data-theme='dark'], mobile-first with max-width 480px container, cards with shadows, bottom nav fixed at bottom. Style all new components: transaction cards, amount displays (green for income, red for expense), category grid, form inputs, summary cards on dashboard.
Update manifest.json: name 'CatatinAja', short_name 'CatatinAja', description 'Catatan Keuangan Pribadi', theme_color '#4F46E5', background_color '#F8FAFC'.
Update sw.js: rename cache to 'catatinaja-v1', update STATIC_ASSETS list to match new file structure (remove api.js, keep others), remove API-specific caching logic (no external APIs).
Update assets/favicon.svg and assets/icon-192.svg and assets/icon-512.svg with a simple wallet/money icon design in indigo color suitable for a financial app.

Ensure the Add Transaction form validates: amount must be > 0, category must be selected. Show inline validation messages in Indonesian. After successful add, redirect to #home and show the new transaction in recent list.
acceptance_criteria: Opening index.html shows CatatinAja dashboard with month summary (Saldo, Pemasukan, Pengeluaran all starting at Rp 0)
Bottom navigation has 4 tabs: Home, Transaksi, Laporan, Pengaturan - all navigate correctly via hash routing
User can add an income transaction with amount, category, description, and date - it persists in localStorage
User can add an expense transaction similarly
Dashboard updates to show correct saldo (income - expenses), total pemasukan, total pengeluaran for current month
Transaction history page shows all transactions grouped by date with amount colored green (income) or red (expense)
User can edit an existing transaction (navigates to edit form pre-filled with data)
User can delete a transaction with confirmation dialog
All category icons display correctly using Font Awesome
Dark mode toggle in settings works and persists
PWA manifest and service worker are correctly configured for CatatinAja
All UI text is in Bahasa Indonesia
verification: Open index.html in browser and verify CatatinAja loads with dashboard showing Rp 0 balances
Navigate between all pages using bottom nav - verify no JS errors in console
Add a sample income transaction (Gaji, Rp 5.000.000) and verify dashboard updates
Add a sample expense transaction (Makanan, Rp 50.000) and verify saldo calculates correctly
Refresh the page and verify transactions persist from localStorage
Edit a transaction and verify the change is reflected
Delete a transaction and verify it is removed
Toggle dark mode in settings and verify theme changes persist after refresh
